title: Musculoskeletal System and Skin
tagline: Bones and joints, fractures, arthritis, connective-tissue disease, back pain and the skin
summary: Musculoskeletal and skin conditions are among the commonest reasons people see a doctor. This course covers bone and joint biology, fractures, osteoarthritis and inflammatory arthritis, connective-tissue disease and vasculitis, back pain, and the structure, common diseases and cancers of the skin.
